detail: Key (NEW at 61ae00920): R1b|fnn-mux-reserve-once|fnn-owner-service-mux-next:mixed-locks. Real, low impact. Writes: fnn-mux-reserve-once (mux.lisp:1827; reads the cursor into fn-mxa-reserve and incf under MUX-SLOT-LOCK) and fnn-mux-adopt's round-robin branch (nth (mod mux-next ..) and incf, under the roster lock R). No common lock, so the two cursor updates can interleave. Worst case: a skipped or doubled round-robin turn; the pending-accept bound (fn-mxa-reservation-keeps-the-pending-bound) does not depend on the cursor, and ACL2 still decides every reservation.
fix: Take the slot lock around the cursor read and incf in fnn-mux-adopt's round-robin branch (verify no path takes the slot lock then R), or give the once-client path its own cursor; then declare the slot protector.
title: Round-robin cursor fnn-owner-service-mux-next is written under the slot lock in fnn-mux-reserve-once and under the roster lock in fnn-mux-adopt (R1b)
